intro.en: Prof. Yuchuan Fan works on agricultural and environmental systems, with research interests spanning climate-smart agriculture, agricultural non-point source pollution control, soil health, agricultural water management, sustainable agroecosystems, ecological restoration, and global ecohydrology. His work connects process-based environmental research with modelling, intelligent sensing, and data-driven approaches to support the interpretation and management of agricultural-environmental challenges.
intro.zh: 范豫川教授长期从事农业与环境系统研究，研究兴趣涵盖气候智慧农业、农业面源污染治理、土壤健康、农水管理、农田生态系统可持续性、生态修复与全球生态水文等方向。他关注农业生产、资源环境与生态过程之间的联系，并致力于将过程研究、模型模拟、智能感知及数据分析方法用于农业环境问题的识别、解释与管理支持。

philosophy.en: Ground research in real agricultural-environmental challenges, combine long-term observation with process understanding and methodological innovation, and develop reliable evidence for agricultural practice and ecological management.
philosophy.zh: 以真实农业环境问题为导向，重视长期观测、过程理解与方法创新的结合；在复杂系统中寻找能够服务生产实践与生态治理的可靠证据。
